contentEn: SIPTRIX is an AI-driven creativity support tool for developing cocktail recipes through interactive exploration. Users build ideas via a mind-graph interface that connects ingredients, sensory qualities, techniques, and inspirations. We held a workshop at Bar Yoru with 11 mixology enthusiasts and 11 professional bartenders; the system helped non-experts articulate inspirations and gave the graph a role as a shared discussion space.
contentZh: SIPTRIX 是一款以 AI 輔助的創意支援工具，透過互動探索協助使用者發展調酒配方。使用者以心智圖介面連結食材、感官特質、技法與靈感。我們在 Bar Yoru 舉辦工作坊，邀請 11 位調酒愛好者與 11 位具三年以上經驗的調酒師參與；系統特別幫助非專家更清楚表達靈感，並讓圖像成為共同討論的空間。

contentEn: Bobapedia is a full-day participatory workshop exploring how computational interfaces can support collaborative flavor creation. An LLM-supported Flavor Wiki helps participants record sensory impressions, personal and cultural associations, and flavor interpretations, then co-edit flavor concepts and iteratively create customized boba tea recipes.
contentZh: Bobapedia 是一場探索計算介面如何支援協作風味創作的全天參與式工作坊。參與者透過 LLM 支援的 Flavor Wiki 記錄感官印象、個人與文化聯想及風味詮釋，再共同編輯風味概念，逐步創作客製化的珍珠奶茶配方。

contentEn: A 2026 workshop with performing-arts students at National Taiwan Normal University explored mobile marker-based WebAR for theater. Participants built simple 3D characters and 30-second AR performance scenes, considering staging, timing, and hybrid presence alongside physical performers.
contentZh: 2026 年與國立台灣師範大學表演藝術研究所學生合作的工作坊，探索行動標記式 WebAR 於劇場的應用。參與者製作簡易 3D 角色與 30 秒 AR 表演片段，思考走位、節奏與實體演出者並存的混合呈現。

titleEn: Immersive Music Exploration and Improvisation Experiences: Design and Development of the Mixed Reality Instrument System "AquaWave"
titleZh: 沉浸式音樂探索與即興體驗：混合實境樂器系統AquaWave的設計與開發
contentEn: AquaWave is a mixed-reality musical instrument system developed with Meta Quest 3 and Unity. It combines full-color passthrough, hand tracking, spatial computing, virtual instruments, and spatial guidance to support intuitive improvisation. Participants adapted quickly, showed diverse performance styles, and experienced less performance anxiety. Wireless projection also created a shared space for collaboration, highlighting the system's potential for accessible, socially connected music-making and mixed-reality learning.
contentZh: AquaWave 是一套以 Meta Quest 3 與 Unity 開發的混合實境音樂樂器系統，結合全彩穿透、手勢追蹤、空間運算、虛擬樂器與路徑引導，支援直覺的即興演奏。研究顯示，參與者能快速上手、展現多元演奏風格並降低演奏焦慮；無線投影建立的共享空間也促進協作與社交連結，展現其在可及音樂創作與混合實境學習上的潛力。

contentEn: GustoGear is a multisensory mixed-reality interface linking virtual events with physical taste and texture. A rotating gear presents flavored conductive jelly units; licking acts as both input and output. The work imagines flavor as programmable material for playful “virtual cooking” between body and digital environments.
contentZh: GustoGear 是一款多感官混合實境介面，將虛擬事件與實體味覺、觸覺連結。旋轉齒輪呈現不同風味的導電果凍單元；舔食同時是輸入也是輸出。作品將風味想像為可編程的材料，在身體與數位環境之間進行 playful 的「虛擬烹飪」。

contentEn: MAX Tongue explores tongue-based interaction in VR using EMG sensing and a lollipop-based demo. Different licking actions move targets in virtual space, inviting users to reconsider the tongue as an expressive input channel. Exhibited at Laval Virtual 2023.
contentZh: MAX Tongue 以 EMG 感測與棒棒糖互動探索 VR 中的舌頭操作。不同舔食動作驅動虛擬目標，邀請使用者重新思考舌頭作為表達性輸入介面。曾於 2023 年 Laval Virtual 展出。

contentEn: A procedural concept art workshop introducing Blender Geometry Nodes. Participants experimented with generative structures—ropes, urban scenes, mechanical spaces—learning procedural thinking as part of creative practice.
contentZh: 一場介紹 Blender Geometry Nodes 的程序化概念藝術工作坊。參與者實驗繩索、都市、機械空間等生成結構，學習將程序化思維融入創作流程。

contentEn: GunShip Battle is a cross-modal study of balance. Players stand on a Wii Fit board in an Oculus Quest 2 and shoot from a small boat while the scene simulates rocking water or a curved surface, so the study can compare how ordinary visuals and VR affect balance when attention has to follow fast-moving targets. Accepted as a poster at TAICHI 2021.
contentZh: GunShip Battle 是一項跨感官平衡覺研究。玩家站在 Wii Fit 平衡板上、配戴 Oculus Quest 2，於小船上射擊，場景則模擬搖晃的水面或彎曲的平面，藉此比較一般影像與 VR 在需要快速追隨移動目標時對平衡覺的影響。此海報論文獲 TAICHI 2021 接受。

contentEn: Shop Vanager looks at the distance between graphical shopping interfaces and a salesperson in a physical shop. A Live2D animated clerk and mobile eye tracking put that clerk on a shopping-app screen, so the study can compare the experience with a normal interface. Accepted as a poster at TAICHI 2020.
contentZh: Shop Vanager 探討現今商城圖形介面與實體店鋪店員推銷之間可能產生的疏離。作品以 Live2D 人偶與行動眼球追蹤，在購物 App 上重現傳統「店員」，並與一般介面比較其對體驗的影響。此海報論文獲 TAICHI 2020 接受。
